integrity: The proof uses only the recurrence stated in the source and the admissible constant function f(m)=1. Exact finite replay is corroborative only; the infinite result is proved inductively. No claim of independent validation is made.
limitations: The result refutes the literal fixed-function quantifier in the abstract/Theorem 1. It does not refute a universally quantified reformulation requiring star_f(n)=-1 for every admissible f, and it does not classify nonconstant f.
title: A constant-function obstruction to a generalized Möbius primality criterion
